landing.h1: Water, shade and a place to rest for delivery riders in the heat.
landing.sub: Pyau shows riders the nearest open, confirmed-today point with a route, and an AI planner recruits hosts before the afternoon heat so gaps get filled.
landing.rider.title: Riders
landing.rider.text: Ask by voice or tap. You see and hear the nearest open water, shade, toilet or charging point, with a scooter route. No account.
landing.host.title: Hosts
landing.host.text: Shops, temples, RWA offices and homes list a point in under a minute and confirm each morning that they are open.
landing.coordinator.title: Coordinators
landing.coordinator.text: See where riders will be without water tomorrow, approve the plan in one click, and watch hosts get asked one by one.
landing.pyau: A pyau is the old street-side water stall: a clay pot and a ladle, free for anyone passing. Pyau brings them back and keeps them open when the heat is worst.
landing.note: Sample scenario: all hosts, requests and temperatures in the demo are invented.
